sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for petitioner would contend that, there is a delay in filing the complaint.
There is a property dispute between the father of the victim girl and petitioner's family and therefore, the petitioner has been falsely implicated.
There are contradictions in the statement of the victim girl with regard to involvement of three persons.
The charge sheet has been filed and in that, there are twenty seven (27) witnesses cited.
The stage of the case is for charge.
With these, he prayed to allow the petition.
NC: 2025:KHC:44383 HC-KAR 4.

Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent No.1 - State would contend that, the statement of the victim girl is recorded under Section 183 of Bharatiya Nagrika Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 indicate the petitioner committing sexual assault on her.
The victim girl became pregnant and gave birth to a male child.
The DNA test report indicates that, the petitioner is the biological father of the child born to the victim girl.
The petitioner is dragging the case by filing application for discharge.
The offence alleged against the petitioner is a heinous offence.
If the petitioner is granted bail, there is a threat to the victim girl and other prosecution witnesses.
With these, he prayed for dismissal of the petition.
5. Having heard the learned counsels appearing for the parties, the Court has perused the charge sheet and other materials placed on record.

6. As per the charge sheet, the case of the prosecution is that, this petitioner who is cousin of the victim girl took her in the guise of talking with her to a NC: 2025:KHC:44383 HC-KAR place in the land where he committed forcible sexual intercourse on her and he repeated the said offence on some other days and threatened the victim girl to kill her father if she intimates the same to anybody.
Due to the act of the petitioner, the victim girl became pregnant and gave birth to a male child on 09.01.2024.
Subsequently, the said child has been given in adoption and subsequently, the child died on 13.03.2024.
The DNA test report indicates that, this petitioner is the biological father of the child born to the victim girl.

7. The Investigating Officer considering doubt regarding the alleged incident committed on the victim girl has sent blood samples of three (3) persons blood samples of the victim girl and her child for DNA test and in the DNA test report indicates that, this petitioner is the biological father of the child born to the victim girl.

The statement of the victim girl has been recorded under Section 183 of Bharatiya Nagrika Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 indicate that, this petitioner has committed forcible sexual intercourse on NC: 2025:KHC:44383 HC-KAR the victim girl.
The victim girl was aged fourteen (14) years as on the date of offence.
8. The charge sheet materials show that, there is a prima-facie case against the petitioner for the offences alleged against him.
If the petitioner is granted bail, there is a threat to the victim girl and other prosecution witnesses.
9. Considering all the above aspects, the petitioner has not made out a case for grant of bail.
In the result, this Criminal Petition is dismissed.
